caption: The drawing shows seven rectangular swatches arranged in a loose grid on a plain, neutral background. The top row features two swatches: the one on the left has a brown base color with a repeating semi-circular or scalloped white and light brown motif, and the one on the right displays alternating vertical stripes in dark brown, blue, teal, and yellow, with blue and white polka dots. The second row has two swatches: the left swatch is brown with a geometric pattern of squares, rectangles, and linework in tan and white, and the right swatch is dark brown with a repeating pattern of large brown circles surrounded by fine yellow dots, connected by yellow lines forming hexagonal shapes. In the center of the arrangement, there is a larger rectangular piece of off-white or beige fabric embroidered with small pink flowers with green stems, arranged with one flower cluster centered near each corner and one in the middle. The bottom row contains two swatches: the left swatch is dark brown with an ornate floral and wave-like pattern in green, yellow, blue, white, and purple; the right swatch is a dark reddish-brown with subtle texture and a small, faint pink and green floral motif in two corners.
title: Materials from Patchwork Bedspread
